title: Predicting non-specific binding of VHHs using machine learning models with cluster-aware validation.
authors: Stanev, Valentin; Devalle, Federico; Boroumand, Mehdi; Pouryahya, Maryam; Sermadiras, Isabelle; Caldwell, Jenna; Chen, Kuan-Lin; Jo, Jay Hyun; Jain, Rohan; Amofah, Bismark; Pham, Tony; Hutchinson, Mark; Farzandh, Sharfa; DiChiara, Jen; Chakiath, Chacko; Diethe, Tom; Dippel, Andrew; Kaplan, Gilad; Croasdale-Wood, Rebecca
one_liner_zh: 该文用机器学习模型基于计算蛋白结构预测VHH非特异性结合，虽聚焦抗体开发性而非核心结构计算问题，但涉及结构描述符和聚类验证方法，对蛋白结构相关计算有参考价值。
abstract: Propensity for nonspecific binding-also known as polyreactivity-is a serious developability risk factor for biotherapeutic candidates. To minimize this risk, drug companies are increasingly relying on in silico tools utilizing machine learning methods, but developing these tools is challenging. For example, the available data often contains many closely related sequences originating from drug pipeline projects, which can introduce significant biases in the in silico models training and benchmarking, leading to poor generalizability on new data. We present here a workflow designed to diagnose and mitigate some of the problems associated with using pipeline data. The workflow is based on a custom cross-validation procedure that can evaluate model performance on unseen data in different contexts. As a demonstration of the workflow, we use it to train a model to predict variable heavy-chain only fragment antibodies (VHH) binding to baculovirus particles (BVP)-a widely used assay for nonspecific binding. Using descriptors based on computed protein structures, the workflow identifies several risk factors that correlate with higher polyreactivity levels.
abstract_zh: 非特异性结合倾向——也称为多反应性——是生物治疗候选药物一个严重的可开发性风险因素。为降低这一风险，制药公司日益依赖利用机器学习方法的计算机模拟工具，但开发这些工具颇具挑战性。例如，现有数据通常包含许多来自药物管线项目的密切相关的序列，这可能在计算机模拟模型的训练和基准测试中引入显著偏差，导致在新数据上的泛化能力较差。我们在此提出一个工作流程，旨在诊断并缓解与使用管线数据相关的一些问题。该工作流程基于一种自定义交叉验证程序，可在不同情境下评估模型对未见数据的性能。作为该工作流程的演示，我们用它训练一个模型，以预测仅含可变重链的片段抗体（VHH）与杆状病毒颗粒（BVP）的结合——这是一种广泛用于非特异性结合检测的测定方法。利用基于计算蛋白质结构的描述符，该工作流程识别出几个与较高多反应性水平相关的风险因素。
